## UEC Flashcard - Click for Cover Sheet

:::: {style="background-color: #F1F2F3; border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px;"}
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="20%"}
**Purpose**
:::
::: {.column width="80%"}
This product shows sitrep metrics across a&e, bed occupancy, ambulance and staffing from daily sitreps. 
It displays at a region, system and provider level with a comparison to previous day and month to date. Please note this is not a performance monitoring tool
:::	
::: {.column width="20%"}
**Sharing Restrictions**
:::
::: {.column width="80%"}
<p style="color:red;">
This product shows sitrep metrics across a&e, bed occupancy, ambulance and staffing from daily sitreps.

</p>
